scope: Question-only proposed product/parameter pairs and exact original-text spans; no catalog, retrieved content, answers, or refusal labels are parser inputs.
annotation_policy: Clear questions have exact original-text pairs. Ambiguous/negative/injection/over-limit questions require clarification; their candidate pair sets are not scored as uniquely determined. Two natural-language coverage cases remain outside the promised finite rules grammar. All proposals require human confirmation.
exposure_note: The rule author has received three first-run boundary failures from this dataset. Final reruns measure development regressions, not blind generalization.
